heading: Reports on certain activities of foreign export credit agencies and of the Export-Import Bank of the United States

tree.heading: Report on certain activities of export credit agencies of foreign countries

children.heading: In general
children.text: Not later than 90 days after July 1, 2010, the President shall submit to the appropriate congressional committees a report on any activity of an export credit agency of a foreign country that is an activity comparable to an activity described in subsection (a) or (b) of section 5 of the Iran Sanctions Act of 1996, as amended by section 102 of this Act.

children.heading: Updates
children.text: The President shall update the report required by paragraph (1) as new information becomes available with respect to the activities of export credit agencies of foreign countries.

tree.heading: Report on certain financing by the Export-Import Bank of the United States
tree.text: Not later than 30 days (or, in extraordinary circumstances, not later than 15 days) before the Export-Import Bank of the United States approves cofinancing (including loans, guarantees, other credits, insurance, and reinsurance) in which an export credit agency of a foreign country identified in the report required by subsection (a) will participate, the President shall submit to the appropriate congressional committees a report identifying—

children.text: the export credit agency of the foreign country; and

notes.heading: Termination of Section
notes.text: For termination of section, see section 8551(a) of this title.

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: Section 5 of the Iran Sanctions Act of 1996, as amended by section 102 of this Act, referred to in subsec. (a)(1), is section 5 of Pub. L. 104–172, as amended by section 102 of Pub. L. 111–195, which is set out as a note under section 1701 of Title 50, War and National Defense.

notes.heading: Delegation of Functions
notes.text: For delegation of functions of President under this section, see Memorandum of President of the United States, Sept. 23, 2010, 75 F.R. 67025, set out as a note under section 8501 of this title.
